data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and any conditions; others may choose 10. If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but cuts low-recovery stock by 16. All 18 leaves 50, then 500 or 100. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. This needn't maximize long-run income.
